title: Herd watch --clear leaves a permanent tombstone indistinguishable from never-armed
description: Finding F2 of the review-epic job (tick brp) in ticfac gate run gate-cia-2 on epic cia: tk herd watch --clear writes a permanent repo-wide tombstone that --status reports identically to never-armed, and it also disables the once-per-run plugin-health check.
acceptance_criteria: --status distinguishes cleared from never-armed; a later spawn re-arms after a clear; the plugin-health check runs once per run regardless of an earlier clear.
